_doc: Talos end-to-end test suite — 65 queries derived from SUITE.md. Run in order; later queries may rely on vault entries forged by earlier ones (e.g. Q12 reuses Q06's Fibonacci tool).

_schema.title: short human label
_schema.query: literal user input. Either this or query_repeat must be set.
_schema.query_repeat: {prefix, repeat, times} → expands into one long string at runtime
_schema.setup: bash commands run before the query, idempotent (creates fixture files etc.)
_schema.requires_hitl: true for queries that need human input; runner skips by default
_schema.depends_on_vault: informational: list of QIDs whose tools this query expects to find in vault

queries.title: web_search primitive
queries.query: What is the current population of Iceland?

queries.title: web_read primitive
queries.query: Read the contents of https://httpbin.org/html and tell me what the page says.

queries.title: python_exec primitive
queries.query: Run this Python code and give me the output: print(sum(range(1, 101)))

queries.title: shell_exec primitive
queries.query: What operating system is this machine running? Use a shell command to find out.

queries.title: file_write + file_read
queries.query: Write the text "Talos test marker" to a file called /tmp/talos_test.txt, then read it back and confirm the contents.

queries.title: Forge — Fibonacci
queries.query: Build me a tool that returns the Nth Fibonacci number. Then use it to get the 20th Fibonacci number.

queries.title: Forge — alternating case
queries.query: Create a tool that takes a string and returns it in alternating case (e.g., "hello" → "hElLo"). Test it on "talos artificial intelligence".

queries.title: Forge — prime factorization
queries.query: Forge a tool that returns the prime factorization of any positive integer. Use it on 84942.

queries.title: Forge — frequency counter
queries.query: Create a tool that takes a list of strings and returns a dictionary mapping each string to its frequency, sorted by frequency descending. Run it on: ["apple", "banana", "apple", "cherry", "banana", "apple"]

queries.title: Forge — Levenshtein
queries.query: Forge a tool that computes the Levenshtein edit distance between two strings. What's the distance between "kitten" and "sitting"?

queries.title: Forge — Caesar cipher
queries.query: Build a Caesar cipher tool that can both encrypt and decrypt. Encrypt "TALOS AGENT" with a shift of 7.

queries.title: Reuse Fibonacci
queries.query: What is the 30th Fibonacci number?

queries.title: Reuse Levenshtein
queries.query: How similar are the words "algorithm" and "altruistic"? Use edit distance.

queries.title: Reuse Caesar (decrypt)
queries.query: Decrypt this Caesar cipher message with shift 7: "AHSVZ HNLUA"

queries.title: Near-miss — forge Hamming
queries.query: Build a tool that computes the Hamming distance between two strings of equal length. What's the Hamming distance between "karolin" and "kathrin"?

queries.title: Web search + synthesis
queries.query: Who won the most recent FIFA World Cup and what was the final score?

queries.title: Web read + summarize
queries.query: Read the Python PEP 8 style guide from https://peps.python.org/pep-0008/ and give me the 5 most important rules.

queries.title: Factual comparison
queries.query: Compare the current GitHub star counts of LangChain and LlamaIndex. Which has more?

queries.title: Multi-hop search→read
queries.query: Find the official LangGraph documentation URL and read their quickstart guide. What are the 3 core concepts they introduce first?

queries.title: Time-sensitive query
queries.query: What is today's date and what is the top trending repository on GitHub right now?

queries.title: Forge — HEX→RGB
queries.query: Build a tool that converts HEX color codes to RGB tuples. Convert #1A2B3C.

queries.title: Forge — Unix timestamp
queries.query: Create a tool that converts a Unix timestamp to a human-readable UTC datetime string. Convert 1700000000.

queries.title: Forge — Haversine
queries.query: Forge a tool that calculates the great-circle distance between two lat/long coordinates using the Haversine formula. Distance from Mumbai (19.076, 72.8777) to Tokyo (35.6762, 139.6503)?

queries.title: Forge — base64 round-trip
queries.query: Build a tool that base64-encodes and decodes strings. Encode "Talos forges tools at runtime" and then decode the result to verify.

queries.title: Forge — std deviation (no numpy)
queries.query: Create a tool that computes the population standard deviation of a list of numbers. No numpy allowed. Compute it for [2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9].

queries.title: Search → save
queries.query: Search the web for the latest Python release version, then write that version number to a file called /tmp/python_version.txt.

queries.title: Read → transform → write
queries.query: Read the file /tmp/talos_test.txt (it should say "Talos test marker"), convert the contents to uppercase, and write the result to /tmp/talos_upper.txt.

queries.title: Research → forge → save
queries.query: Look up the current Bitcoin price in USD, then forge a tool that converts USD to INR at a rate of 83.5, convert the BTC price, and save the INR amount to /tmp/btc_inr.txt.

queries.title: Two forges in one plan
queries.query: Create a tool that generates a random password of a given length (letters, digits, symbols). Then create a separate tool that scores password strength (weak/medium/strong based on length, character diversity). Generate a 16-char password and score it.

queries.title: JSON endpoint parse
queries.query: Read the page at https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users and tell me how many users have email addresses ending in .biz.
queries.notes: JSONPlaceholder returns 10 users; about 5 have .biz emails (varies slightly).

queries.title: Vault Fib + file_write
queries.query: What's the Fibonacci number at position 15, and write that number to /tmp/fib15.txt?

queries.title: Vault Haversine reuse
queries.query: Find the distance in km between the Eiffel Tower coordinates (48.8584, 2.2945) and the Statue of Liberty coordinates (40.6892, -74.0445) using the haversine tool.

queries.title: Research + forge + execute
queries.query: Search the web for the top 5 most popular programming languages in 2025, forge a tool that takes a ranked list and formats it as a numbered markdown list, then apply the tool to the results.

queries.title: Two vault tools chained
queries.query: Take the string "Hello World", compute its Caesar cipher with shift 3, then compute the Levenshtein distance between the original and the encrypted version.

queries.title: API key request
queries.query: Use the OpenWeatherMap API to get the current temperature in Mumbai.

queries.title: Clarification interrupt
queries.query: Convert the data.

queries.title: Preference interrupt
queries.query: Generate a color palette for a website. I want 5 colors.

queries.title: Forge retry — email regex
queries.query: Build a tool that validates email addresses using regex. It should handle edge cases like "user+tag@sub.domain.com" and reject "user@@domain" and "@domain.com".

queries.title: Timeout stress — primes
queries.query: Forge a tool that finds all prime numbers up to N. Run it with N = 10000000.

queries.title: Impossible — graceful refusal
queries.query: Forge a tool that accurately predicts stock prices for tomorrow.

queries.title: Missing dependency
queries.query: Build a tool that uses the 'obscurelib42' package to transform data.

queries.title: Malformed input to vault tool
queries.query: Use the prime factorization tool on -17.

queries.title: No useful results
queries.query: Find the detailed quarterly revenue breakdown for Yathendra's Lemonade Stand Inc. in Q3 2025.

query_repeat.repeat: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

queries.title: One-liner — primitive route
queries.query: Calculate 2 ** 100.

queries.title: UUID v4 (either route)
queries.query: Generate a UUID v4.

queries.title: Three vault tools chained
queries.query: Encode the string "Test123" in base64, then compute the Levenshtein distance between the original and encoded strings, then check if the distance value is a prime number using factorization.

queries.title: Self-referential — list vault
queries.query: How many tools are currently in your skill vault? List them all.

queries.title: Full showcase — repo comparison
queries.query: I want to compare two GitHub repos: langchain-ai/langchain and run-llama/llama_index. Search for their star counts, forge a tool that takes two numbers and computes the percentage difference, apply it to the star counts, then format the result as a one-line summary and save it to /tmp/repo_comparison.txt.

queries.title: Date normalizer
queries.query: I have a list of dates in mixed formats: ["2025-01-15", "March 3, 2025", "15/06/2025", "2025.09.01", "Jan 7 2025"]. Normalize them all to YYYY-MM-DD.

queries.title: CSV column add
queries.query: I have a CSV file at /tmp/sales.csv with columns: product, price, quantity. Add a new column called "revenue" that's price × quantity, and save the result to /tmp/sales_with_revenue.csv.

queries.title: Log parser
queries.query:
Parse this nginx-style log and tell me how many requests per HTTP status code: "GET /api 200
POST /login 401
GET /home 200
GET /api 500
POST /login 200
GET /api 200
GET /home 404
POST /login 401". Give me the counts sorted by frequency.

queries.title: JSON flattener
queries.query: I have deeply nested JSON and I need it flat. Build something that takes nested JSON like {"user": {"name": "Yath", "address": {"city": "Mumbai", "zip": "400001"}}, "active": true} and flattens it to {"user.name": "Yath", "user.address.city": "Mumbai", "user.address.zip": "400001", "active": true}.

queries.title: Text file analyzer
queries.query: I keep needing to analyze text files. Make me a tool that takes a file path and returns: total words, unique words, average word length, and the top 10 most frequent words with counts. Try it on /tmp/talos_upper.txt.

queries.title: JSON↔YAML config
queries.query: Convert this JSON config to YAML format: {"app": "talos", "version": "0.1.0", "settings": {"llm": "gpt-4o", "temperature": 0.7, "tools": ["web_search", "web_read", "python_exec"]}, "debug": false}. Save both the pretty-printed JSON and the YAML to /tmp/config.json and /tmp/config.yaml.

queries.title: Slug generator
queries.query: I need a URL slug generator. It should take a title like "My Amazing Blog Post! (Part 2)" and return "my-amazing-blog-post-part-2". Handle special chars, multiple spaces, leading/trailing hyphens. Try it on "  LangGraph: Build Stateful AI Agents — A Guide! ".

queries.title: Batch renamer
queries.query: I have files in /tmp/rename_test/ and I want to rename them all by replacing spaces with underscores and converting to lowercase. Build a tool for this and run it.
queries.setup: rm -rf /tmp/rename_test && mkdir -p /tmp/rename_test && touch '/tmp/rename_test/My Document.txt' '/tmp/rename_test/Photo From Trip.jpg' '/tmp/rename_test/REPORT Final.pdf'

queries.title: Diff detector
queries.query: Compare the files /tmp/talos_test.txt and /tmp/talos_upper.txt and tell me what changed between them. Show the differences clearly.
queries.setup: mkdir -p /tmp && printf 'Talos test marker' > /tmp/talos_test.txt && printf 'TALOS TEST MARKER' > /tmp/talos_upper.txt

queries.title: Markdown table
queries.query: Take this data and format it as a clean markdown table: headers are ["Agent", "Framework", "Key Feature"], rows are [["Talos", "LangGraph", "Self-evolving tools"], ["Voyager", "Custom", "Minecraft skills"], ["GenericAgent", "None", "Skill crystallization"]]. Save it to /tmp/comparison.md.

queries.title: Universal unit converter
queries.query: Build me a universal unit converter that handles: km↔miles, kg↔pounds, celsius↔fahrenheit, liters↔gallons. Convert 42km to miles, 100°F to celsius, and 75kg to pounds.

queries.title: Regex helper
queries.query: I always mess up regexes. Build me a tool that takes a regex pattern and a test string, and returns: whether it matches, all match groups, and all match positions. Test it with pattern "(\\d{3})-(\\d{4})" on the string "Call 555-1234 or 800-5678 for help".

queries.title: Reuse date normalizer
queries.query: Normalize these dates for me: ["December 25, 2025", "2025/04/01", "07-11-2025"].

queries.title: Compound vault workflow
queries.query: Read the file /tmp/config.json, flatten the nested JSON structure, then generate a markdown table showing each key-value pair, and save it to /tmp/config_table.md.

queries.title: Full showcase — ISS mass
queries.query: Find the current top mass of the International Space Station, build a tool that converts kg to every common unit (pounds, ounces, grams, metric tons), run the conversion on the ISS mass, format the results as a markdown table, and save it to /tmp/iss_mass.md.
